limits: Static sites only, no original execution
Type hierarchy/slot candidates require reading branches and arguments
Arithmetic sites are xrefs, not an executable formula
Predictions require resolved virtual targets and normally returning opaque helpers
No timing measurements, original CLR conversion probes or geometry equivalence
No original Windows/CLR/provider/coordinate conversion or surrogate execution
Active provider and host/DPI/viewport/layout values require original runtime observation
Float-declared CIL order is preserved; target JIT intermediate precision not measured
CS-like field alias is from original size dataflow; literal parser key remains undecoded
No visual-border equality, full graphics projection or overlapping-object arbitration recovered
Direct field inventory excludes reflective/external/native mutation
offset_basis: first CIL opcode; headers excluded; EH already code-relative
